slice: PR 2 of 3: the touch context group. Every context control (cylinders, gas information, fast-forward, torch, setpoint -/+, bailout, help, mute) is pressed by click (mouse, keyboard, a lone tap) and by any finger lifted over it (src/app/touch-press.ts), so a second finger works it while a thumb holds the D-pad, as legacy's touchstart binding does; the groups are named; the torch names T; press feedback on the dock and topbar
